variation: Standing bilateral supinated dumbbell curl, strict torso, both arms together
camera: Fixed almost-front three-quarter view, athlete turned 15 degrees towards image left; both hands and dumbbells fully visible. Portrait 1024x1536, whole head and shoes in frame, camera near lower chest height, no perspective/scale changes.
anchors: Both shoe soles, heels, toes, pelvis, head and shoulders remain fixed. Upper arms remain beside ribs. Only elbow flexion and attached forearms/hands/dumbbells move.
equipment: Two identical modest round-ended dark-grey dumbbells; same handle length and head diameter in all six. No numerical weight labels. Each hand fully wraps its handle, palms forward/up throughout.
primary: Biceps brachii on both arms, deep purple
secondary: Visible brachialis and brachioradialis only, lighter lilac
stabilisers: Subtle pale purple at forearm grip muscles and trunk only; leave chest, deltoids and legs white-grey.

states.body: setup: stand upright with both elbows near straight and palms forward. Shoulders, upper arms, head, torso, pelvis, knees and feet hold the master position. Neutral wrists and supinated grip.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

states.body: middle curl: bend both elbows so the dumbbells sit in front of the waist. Upper arms remain beside ribs, torso upright and wrists neutral. Feet and head stay registered with the master.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

states.body: top: dumbbells approach shoulder height as both elbows flex. Keep upper arms beside ribs, neutral wrists and supinated grips, without leaning back or driving the shoulders forward.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

states.body: controlled top hold: same joint configuration as frame3. Keep upper arms beside ribs, wrists straight and torso still before reversing the movement.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

states.body: controlled lower: return through the same waist-height middle pose as frame2. Extend the elbows under control while keeping upper arms beside ribs and wrists neutral.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

states.body: reset: return to the original near-straight setup without snapping the elbows. Same pose as frame1, supinated grips, upright torso and planted feet.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.

loopBoundary: Frame6 completes the controlled return and reuses the setup pose from frame1. Frame5 reuses the middle pose from frame2, and frame4 holds frame3. The6-to1 boundary is stationary before the next curl.
